roadmap.title: Protect your horse and finish New Austin
roadmap.description: Choose Normal and keep the same owned horse for 20 story missions. Save between missions. Start the Ambient Challenges, keep a Pardon Letter, and use both handgun and long-gun weapons.

roadmap.title: Complete the Mexico story
roadmap.description: Continue the story into Nuevo Paraiso. Use Lucky in Love for the poker achievement, clear the Mexican hideouts and start the regional Stranger tasks.

roadmap.title: Finish the base game and its 100% checklist
roadmap.description: Explore West Elizabeth, finish the story and complete Remember My Family. Finish the challenges, outfits, properties, bounties and minigames. Max out Fame and Honor before the crime achievements; make a separate save for those.

roadmap.title: Play Undead Nightmare
roadmap.description: Start the separate Undead Nightmare campaign. Save towns, break mythical horses and advance the challenge tracks as you follow the story. Finish Explosive Rifle Mastery while wearing the US Army Uniform during American Imperialism.

roadmap.title: Complete Undead Nightmare and remaining kills
roadmap.description: Make every territory safe together. Finish the four Undead challenge tracks, hunt the Chupacabra, break the unicorn and reach 100% completion. Farm any remaining mounted-weapon kills at El Presidio.

achievements.description: Finish “Exodus in America”, a main-story mission.
achievements.summary: Finish “Exodus in America”, a main-story mission.

steps.text: Play through @mechanic{Exodus in America} in the main campaign.

achievements.description: Finish “The Assault on Fort Mercer”, a main-story mission.
achievements.summary: Finish “The Assault on Fort Mercer”, a main-story mission.

steps.text: Play through @mechanic{The Assault on Fort Mercer} in the main campaign.

achievements.description: Finish “The Gates of El Presidio”, a main-story mission.
achievements.summary: Finish “The Gates of El Presidio”, a main-story mission.

steps.text: Play through @mechanic{The Gates of El Presidio} in the main campaign.

achievements.description: Finish “An Appointed Time”, a main-story mission.
achievements.summary: Finish “An Appointed Time”, a main-story mission.

steps.text: Play through @mechanic{An Appointed Time} in the main campaign.

achievements.description: Finish “At Home with Dutch”, a main-story mission.
achievements.summary: Finish “At Home with Dutch”, a main-story mission.

steps.text: Play through @mechanic{At Home with Dutch} in the main campaign.

achievements.description: Finish “And the Truth Will Set You Free”, a main-story mission.
achievements.summary: Finish “And the Truth Will Set You Free”, a main-story mission.

steps.text: Play through @mechanic{And the Truth Will Set You Free} in the main campaign.

achievements.description: Finish “The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed”, a main-story mission.
achievements.summary: Finish “The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed”, a main-story mission.

steps.text: Play through @mechanic{The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed} in the main campaign.

achievements.description: Finish the Stranger mission “Remember My Family”.
achievements.summary: Finish the Stranger mission “Remember My Family”.

steps.text: With @mechanic{The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed} finished, speak to @npc{Howard Sawicki} at @loc{Blackwater train station} to start @mechanic{Remember My Family}.
Follow the leads from @loc{Lake Don Julio} to @loc{Rio del Toro}. Find @npc{Edgar Ross} farther downriver and win the duel.

achievements.description: Win over 2000 chips in a hand of Poker.
achievements.summary: Win a poker hand with a pot worth more than 2,000 chips.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Lucky in Love}, or replay it through @mechanic{Stats > Missions}. The poker section gives you winning cards.
Raise in small amounts so the other players stay in. Win a pot above @item{2,000 chips} before the second hand ends; restart the mission if the accusation interrupts you.

achievements.description: Complete a game of Liar's Dice without losing a single die.
achievements.summary: Win Liar’s Dice while retaining all five starting dice.

steps.text: Save, then join @mechanic{Liar’s Dice} in @loc{Casa Madrugada}, @loc{Escalera} or @loc{Thieves’ Landing}. Prefer a table with one opponent.
Make conservative bids using the dice under your cup. Call a bluff when the bid is impossible, such as more dice than remain on the table.
Eliminate the other players while keeping all five dice. If you lose a die, quit and start another game.

achievements.description: Get a ringer in a game of Horseshoes.
achievements.summary: Throw a ringer around the stake in a game of Horseshoes.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Horseshoes} at @loc{MacFarlane’s Ranch} with a $1 bet. Aim the opening of the horseshoe at the stake, swing smoothly, and release near the power marker. Adjust your next throw until a horseshoe surrounds the stake.

achievements.description: Complete Twin Rocks, Pike's Basin, and Gaptooth Breach Hideouts.
achievements.summary: Clear the gang hideouts at Gaptooth Breach, Twin Rocks and Pike’s Basin.

guide.context: These are free-roam hideout activities. Story missions at the same locations do not replace them.

steps.text: At @loc{Twin Rocks}, help the rancher outside. Kill the gunmen on the rocks and in the yard, then kill the captor inside the house to rescue his daughter.
After @mechanic{Justice in Pike’s Basin}, return to @loc{Pike’s Basin}. Protect the rancher and kill the gang members in the camps and along the canyon.

After @mechanic{Man is Born Unto Trouble}, start @loc{Gaptooth Breach} with the contact outside. Free @npc{Floyd} upstairs in the rail building, clear the mine, open the marked chest and leave through the mine exit.

achievements.description: Complete Tumbleweed and Tesoro Azul Hideouts.
achievements.summary: Clear the Tumbleweed and Tesoro Azul gang hideouts.

steps.text: After @mechanic{New Friends, Old Problems}, go to @loc{Tumbleweed}. Free the sheriff and kill the gang members in town and inside the mansion.
After @mechanic{The Demon Drink}, meet the contact at the east entrance of @loc{Tesoro Azul}. Clear the town, then kill the leader inside the house without shooting his hostage.

achievements.description: Complete Fort Mercer and Nosalida Hideouts.
achievements.summary: Clear the Fort Mercer and Nosalida gang hideouts.

steps.text: The @loc{Fort Mercer} hideout opens once you finish @mechanic{The Assault on Fort Mercer}. Join @npc{Leon}, enter the fort and clear the defenders. Open the gate, defeat the reinforcements and leaders, then loot the marked chests.

The @loc{Nosalida} hideout opens once you finish @mechanic{We Shall Be Together in Paradise}. Meet the general outside. Use his @item{Fire Bottles} to burn the marked buildings and boats, kill the rebels, then return to him.

achievements.description: Knock someone out in melee in every saloon in the game.
achievements.summary: Knock out a person with your fists inside each of the seven saloons.

guide.context: Armed patrons will stand and fight. Leave after the knockout, before they recover and draw a gun.

collectibles.name: Armadillo
collectibles.method: Select @mechanic{Fist} in the weapon wheel and punch a patron until they collapse.

collectibles.name: Thieves’ Landing
collectibles.method: Select @mechanic{Fist} in the weapon wheel and punch a patron until they collapse.

collectibles.name: Rathskeller Fork
collectibles.method: Select @mechanic{Fist} in the weapon wheel and punch a patron until they collapse.

collectibles.method: Select @mechanic{Fist} in the weapon wheel and punch a patron until they collapse.

collectibles.name: Escalera
collectibles.method: Select @mechanic{Fist} in the weapon wheel and punch a patron until they collapse.

collectibles.name: Casa Madrugada
collectibles.method: Select @mechanic{Fist} in the weapon wheel and punch a patron until they collapse.

collectibles.name: Blackwater
collectibles.method: Select @mechanic{Fist} in the weapon wheel and punch a patron until they collapse.

achievements.description: Complete a task for a Stranger.
achievements.summary: Finish one complete Stranger task.

steps.text: After @mechanic{This is Armadillo, USA}, find @npc{Jenny} near @loc{Ridgewood Farm} and give her @item{Medicine} to finish @mechanic{Jenny’s Faith}.

achievements.description: Complete 15 tasks for Strangers.
achievements.summary: Finish 15 complete Stranger task chains.

guide.context: White question marks begin tasks; purple markers continue them. Finish each whole chain. This list contains the 18 tasks needed for base-game 100%; “I Know You” is optional. If a continuation is absent, advance the story or let a few game days pass.

collectibles.name: Jenny’s Faith
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{This is Armadillo, USA}, give @npc{Jenny} Medicine.

collectibles.name: Flowers for a Lady
collectibles.location: Stillwater Creek, on the road to Thieves’ Landing
collectibles.method: Bring @npc{Billy} 3 Wild Feverfew, 3 Red Sage and 3 Desert Sage.

collectibles.name: Let No Man Put Asunder
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{Obstacles in Our Path}, speak to the woman at the chapel and follow the task markers.

collectibles.name: Water and Honesty
collectibles.location: Road between Armadillo and MacFarlane’s Ranch
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{Political Realities in Armadillo}, accept the water-finding task and finish its marked objectives.

collectibles.name: American Appetites
collectibles.method: Complete each missing-person search. Later parts open after @mechanic{Justice in Pike’s Basin} and @mechanic{Wild Horses, Tamed Passions}.

collectibles.name: California
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{Women and Cattle}, meet the traveler. Return for each purple continuation marker after time passes.

collectibles.name: Funny Man
collectibles.method: Meet @npc{Jimmy Saint}, then rescue him at @loc{Gaptooth Breach}, @loc{Pike’s Basin} and @loc{Tesoro Azul} as the story opens those parts.

collectibles.name: Who Are You to Judge?
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{Liars, Cheats, and Other Proud Americans}, accept the search and return the missing companion.

collectibles.name: Lights, Camera, Action
collectibles.method: Start after @mechanic{The Sport of Kings, and Liars}. Complete the marked jobs, then finish the later meeting at @loc{Pacific Union Railroad Camp} after @mechanic{An Appointed Time}.

collectibles.name: Daedalus and Son
collectibles.location: Cliffs above the road from Casa Madrugada to El Presidio
collectibles.method: Bring 10 Red Sage, 20 feathers and 5 Beaver Furs. Hunt beavers around @loc{Aurora Basin} after West Elizabeth opens. Return again when the next marker appears.

collectibles.name: Eva in Peril
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{Lucky in Love}, pay $200 to free @npc{Eva}. Follow the later leads through @loc{Las Hermanas} to @loc{Sepulcro}.

collectibles.name: Poppycock
collectibles.method: Start after @mechanic{Civilization, at Any Price}. Collect the marked package at @loc{Nosalida}, deliver it to @loc{El Matadero}, then return to the giver.

collectibles.name: Love is the Opiate
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{Empty Promises} and @mechanic{Poppycock}, deliver a @item{Hungarian Half-bred}. Finish by meeting @npc{Zhou} later at @loc{Chuparosa station}.

collectibles.name: Aztec Gold
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{Must a Savior Die?}, accept the search. Collect the marked map fragments and follow @npc{Basilio} into the cave at @loc{El Matadero}.

collectibles.name: American Lobbyist
collectibles.location: Blackwater gazebo beside the municipal office
collectibles.method: Start after @mechanic{An Appointed Time}. Deliver the blackmail photographs to the marked man across the courtyard.

collectibles.name: The Wronged Woman
collectibles.method: Start after @mechanic{An Appointed Time}. Finish @npc{Clara}’s marked task, then return for the later graveyard meeting.

collectibles.name: The Prohibitionist
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{The Wronged Woman}, accept the task. Resolve the threat against @npc{Abner Forsyth}, then report back.

collectibles.name: Remember My Family
collectibles.method: With @mechanic{The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed} finished, follow the leads through @loc{Lake Don Julio} and @loc{Rio del Toro}, then win the final duel.

achievements.description: Break the Kentucky Saddler, the American Standardbred, and the Hungarian Half-bred.
achievements.summary: Break a Kentucky Saddler, a Hungarian Half-bred and an American Standardbred.

guide.context: Buying horse deeds does not replace breaking wild horses. While working on Spurred to Victory, do not hitch a different horse.

steps.text: Break the golden @item{Kentucky Saddler} during @mechanic{Wild Horses, Tamed Passions}, or find one near @loc{Hanging Rock}.
Find a white @item{Hungarian Half-bred} with a dark mane in @loc{Nuevo Paraiso}, including @loc{Diez Coronas}. Lasso and mount the horse, then keep centered until the bucking stops.
Find an all-black @item{American Standardbred} in @loc{Great Plains}, around @loc{Beecher’s Hope}. Lasso and break the horse as well.

achievements.description: Capture a bounty alive.
achievements.summary: Deliver a wanted bounty target to jail alive.

steps.text: After @mechanic{Political Realities in Armadillo}, take a skull-marked bounty poster and travel to the marked target.

Kill the escorts, then lasso and hogtie the target marked with a skull. Put the prisoner on your horse and deliver them to the marked jail alive; shoot pursuing gang members before they kill the prisoner.

achievements.description: Witness a train kill a woman you have hogtied and placed on the tracks.
achievements.summary: Witness a train kill a woman you have hogtied and placed on the tracks.

steps.text: Once Bonnie’s missions give you the @item{Lasso}, hogtie a woman and carry her on your horse to a railway near an approaching train icon.
Set her on the rails, move clear, and stay nearby until the train hits her.

achievements.description: Purchase a rare weapon from a gunsmith.
achievements.summary: Buy a rare weapon from a gunsmith.

steps.text: Buy a @item{LeMat Revolver} or @item{Semi-auto Shotgun} at the @loc{Escalera gunsmith}, or a @item{Mauser Pistol}, @item{Evans Repeater} or @item{Carcano Rifle} at the @loc{Blackwater gunsmith}.

achievements.description: Kill and skin 18 grizzly bears.
achievements.summary: Kill and skin 18 grizzly bears.

steps.text: Hunt grizzly bears in @loc{Tall Trees}, north of @loc{Manzanita Post}. Kill each bear with a strong firearm, check for other bears, then skin the carcass. Save between hunts until you have skinned 18.

achievements.description: Obtain the Elegant Suit.
achievements.summary: Unlock the Elegant Suit.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Elegant Suit} scrap from the @loc{Thieves’ Landing tailor} for $70, then use the scrap from your inventory.

achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative total of $10,000.

steps.text: Earn money from missions and live bounties, then sell treasure gold, animal parts and herbs until total earnings reach @item{$10,000}. You can spend money along the way.

achievements.description: Obtain Legendary rank in any Ambient Challenge.
achievements.summary: Reach Legendary rank 10 in one base-game Ambient Challenge.

guide.context: Treasure Hunter is one route to Legendary rank. Each treasure contains the map for the next rank, so follow this list in order. Later regions open through the story. Save after collecting treasure; challenge progress does not force an autosave.

collectibles.name: First treasure map — rank 1
collectibles.method: Rescue the treasure hunter from the bandits and take his map, or loot his body if he dies.

collectibles.name: Hanging Rock — rank 2
collectibles.location: Gap between the smaller rocks beside Hanging Rock
collectibles.method: Search the stone pile against the large rock.

collectibles.name: Del Lobo Rock — rank 3
collectibles.location: Cliff ledge below the summit camp
collectibles.method: From the camp, pass through the gap to the south. Descend carefully to the lower ledge and search its stone pile.

collectibles.name: Tumbleweed — rank 4
collectibles.method: Use the cellar entrance on the south side. Search the stone pile by the west basement wall.

collectibles.name: Rio del Toro — rank 5
collectibles.location: North of Chuparosa, near the river
collectibles.method: Find the tree decorated with skulls. Go north toward the river and search around the wall beyond the road.

collectibles.name: Crooked Toes — rank 6
collectibles.method: Climb the tallest rock and search the stone pile.

collectibles.name: Ojo del Diablo — rank 7
collectibles.location: Southwest end of the stone arch
collectibles.method: Follow the short path beneath the arch to the stone pile.

collectibles.name: Roca de Madera — rank 8
collectibles.location: Cliff ledge southwest of the landmark
collectibles.method: Follow the narrow ledge below the cliff top to the stone pile at its end.

collectibles.name: Broken Tree — rank 9
collectibles.method: Search between the broken wall sections beside the tree.

collectibles.name: Nekoti Rock — rank 10
collectibles.location: Cave at the end of the trail north of Nekoti Rock
collectibles.method: Enter the cave and search the stone pile against the far wall.

achievements.description: Score a headshot on any enemy using Expert targeting mode.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a headshot while using Expert targeting.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Options > Gamepad}, set @mechanic{Targeting Mode} to @mechanic{Expert}. Kill an enemy with a headshot; @mechanic{Dead Eye} is allowed.

achievements.description: Attain highest Fame rank and either highest Honor rank or lowest Honor rank.
achievements.summary: Reach maximum Fame while also having maximum or minimum Honor.

steps.text: Remove the @item{Bandana} so reputation can change. Build Fame through missions, Stranger tasks, hideouts and duels.
For the high-Honor route, help civilians and deliver bounties alive. Keep doing good deeds until Honor is full and Fame is also at its maximum.

achievements.description: Earn a Gold Medal Rank for a combat mission.
achievements.summary: Earn a gold medal on a combat mission.

steps.text: Replay @mechanic{Political Realities in Armadillo} through @mechanic{Stats > Missions}. Aim for a time under 2:30, at least 5 headshots and 100% accuracy.
Skip cutscenes for the fast run. If needed, replay more carefully for headshots and accuracy; the mission keeps your best result in each category across replays.

achievements.description: Kill the last surviving buffalo in the Great Plains herd.
achievements.summary: Kill the last surviving buffalo in the Great Plains herd.

guide.context: Killed buffalo do not respawn. Skinning is unnecessary.

steps.text: Find the buffalo in @loc{Great Plains} and use @mechanic{Dead Eye} with a repeating firearm to kill the herd before it scatters.
If survivors disappear, leave the area for a game day and return. Kill the remaining buffalo until all 20 are dead.

achievements.displayName: On the Trail of de Vaca
achievements.description: Uncover every location on the map.
achievements.summary: Reveal all 94 locations on the base-game map.

guide.context: Stores and regions open with the story. Check your discovered-location total after reading the maps. If it is below 94, visit unrevealed locations directly; check Plata Grande, Puerto Cuchillo and the smaller named landmarks first.

collectibles.name: Hennigan’s Stead map
collectibles.method: Purchase the map and read it from your inventory.

collectibles.name: Cholla Springs map
collectibles.method: Purchase the map and read it from your inventory.

collectibles.name: Gaptooth Ridge map
collectibles.method: Purchase the map and read it from your inventory.

collectibles.name: Rio Bravo map
collectibles.method: Purchase the map and read it from your inventory.

collectibles.method: Purchase the map and read it from your inventory.

collectibles.method: Purchase the map and read it from your inventory.

collectibles.method: Purchase the map and read it from your inventory.

collectibles.method: Purchase the map and read it from your inventory.

achievements.description: Use a pardon letter with more than $5000 bounty.
achievements.summary: Clear a bounty greater than $5,000 by using a Pardon Letter.

steps.text: Keep a @item{Pardon Letter} from a gang hideout or Seth’s early story mission. Make a separate save before committing crimes.
Fight responding lawmen in @loc{Blackwater}, using a rooftop for cover. Build your bounty above @item{$5,000}; escape and save when you need to restock.
Once the wanted search ends, visit a @loc{telegraph office}. Choose @mechanic{Use Pardon Letter} to clear the bounty. Paying with cash does not unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Attain 100% in the Game Completion stat.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% in the base game’s Game Completion statistic.

guide.context: Tomahawk and Explosive Rifle challenges have separate achievements and add nothing to this completion percentage.

steps.text: Finish all 57 story missions and the 18 Stranger chains listed under @mechanic{People are Still Strange}. Skip @mechanic{I Know You} if you wish; it adds no completion credit.

Clear @loc{Twin Rocks}, @loc{Pike’s Basin}, @loc{Gaptooth Breach}, @loc{Tumbleweed}, @loc{Tesoro Azul}, @loc{Fort Mercer} and @loc{Nosalida}. The separate @loc{Solomon’s Folly} hideout is unnecessary.

Complete bounties at all 8 target locations in @loc{New Austin}, 8 in @loc{Nuevo Paraiso} and 4 in @loc{West Elizabeth}. Check the regional @mechanic{Bounty Locations} counters in @mechanic{Stats > Score}; repeated locations do not fill a missing one. Bring Bollard Twins, Treasure Hunter and Bandito targets in alive for outfit scraps.

Buy the permanent homes in @loc{Armadillo}, @loc{Thieves’ Landing}, @loc{Rathskeller Fork}, @loc{Escalera}, @loc{Chuparosa}, @loc{El Matadero}, @loc{Casa Madrugada} and @loc{Manzanita Post}. The remaining permanent homes come through the story; rentals are unnecessary.
Complete Horsebreaking at @loc{Ridgewood Farm} and @loc{Chuparosa}. After dark, finish a Nightwatch job in each of @loc{Blackwater}, @loc{MacFarlane’s Ranch} and @loc{Chuparosa}.

Win Horseshoes at @loc{MacFarlane’s Ranch} and leave Blackjack at @loc{Rathskeller Fork} with a profit. Defeat every opponent at Poker in @loc{Blackwater}, Liar’s Dice in @loc{Casa Madrugada}, Five Finger Fillet in @loc{Torquemada} and Arm Wrestling at @loc{Pacific Union Railroad Camp}. These locations also fulfill outfit scraps.

In @loc{Escalera}, buy the @item{Semi-auto Shotgun} and @item{LeMat Revolver}. In @loc{Blackwater}, buy the @item{Carcano Rifle}, @item{Mauser Pistol} and @item{Evans Repeater}. Reveal all 94 locations using the territorial maps listed under @mechanic{On the Trail of de Vaca}.

Reach rank 10 in @mechanic{Treasure Hunter}, @mechanic{Survivalist}, @mechanic{Master Hunter} and @mechanic{Sharpshooter}. Follow @mechanic{Frontiersman} for the treasure route. Check @mechanic{Journal > Challenges} before collecting or killing: only the active rank earns progress.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 1}, gather 6 @item{Wild Feverfew} in @loc{Hennigan’s Stead} or @loc{Cholla Springs}. Use a @item{Survivalist Map} to reveal nearby plants.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 2}, gather 6 @item{Desert Sage} in @loc{Gaptooth Ridge}.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 3}, gather 4 @item{Red Sage} in @loc{Rio Bravo}.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 4}, gather 8 @item{Prickly Pear} in @loc{Punta Orgullo}.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 5}, gather 7 @item{Woolly Blue Curls} in @loc{Perdido}.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 6}, gather 8 @item{Butterfly Weed} in @loc{Diez Coronas}.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 7}, gather 10 @item{Hummingbird Sage} in @loc{Tall Trees}.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 8}, gather 12 @item{Prairie Poppy} in @loc{Great Plains}.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 9}, gather 15 @item{Golden Currant} in @loc{Great Plains}.
At @mechanic{Survivalist rank 10}, gather 10 @item{Violet Snowdrop} in @loc{Tall Trees}. Also pick 2 new plants of each herb from ranks 1–9.

For Master Hunter, follow the Journal’s animal quantities and skin the kills. Use @loc{Stillwater Creek} for boars, @loc{Rio Bravo} for cougars and foxes, @loc{Armadillo/Hanging Rock} at night for raccoons and skunks, and @loc{Tall Trees} for elk, bighorn and bears. At knife-kill ranks, weaken the animal with a gun if needed, then finish with the knife. Deer with antlers do not count for the deer rank. Stock Medicine and save after dangerous hunts.

For the final Master Hunter ranks, kill and skin @enemy{Khan} at @loc{Ojo del Diablo}, then @enemy{Lobo} near @loc{Aurora Basin}, @enemy{Gordo} at @loc{Stillwater Creek} and @enemy{Brumas} at @loc{Nekoti Rock}. Use bait and follow the animal marker when it appears.

For Sharpshooter’s hats and disarms, aim at hat brims and weapons rather than heads or bodies. Use a loaded @item{Evans Repeater} for the six-animal and six-disarm ranks, without reloading or changing weapons. During the final disarms, use Dead Eye to slow time and fire manually; marking targets can refill the gun and reset the attempt.

Unlock @item{Elegant Suit}, @item{Bollard Twins Outfit}, @item{Treasure Hunter Outfit}, @item{Bandito Outfit}, @item{Reyes’ Rebels Outfit}, @item{Mexican Poncho}, @item{Rancher Outfit}, @item{US Army Uniform} and @item{US Marshal Uniform}. Use @mechanic{Outfits > Track} to locate unfinished scraps.

For @item{Bollard Twins Outfit}, loot the chest in the upstairs warehouse office at @loc{Thieves’ Landing}. Complete Nightwatch at @loc{MacFarlane’s Ranch} and win Horseshoes there. Deliver a Bollard Twins bounty alive. Rescue residents from Bollards in @loc{Hennigan’s Stead}. Buy the final scrap at the Thieves’ Landing tailor.

For @item{Treasure Hunter Outfit}, loot the house chest at @loc{Silent Stead}. Finish @mechanic{California}. Leave Blackjack at @loc{Rathskeller Fork} with a profit. Deliver a Treasure Hunter bounty alive. Clear @loc{Gaptooth Breach}. Buy the final scrap at the Thieves’ Landing tailor.

For @item{Bandito Outfit}, loot the camp chest at @loc{Sidewinder Gulch}. Complete Nightwatch at @loc{Chuparosa}. Win Liar’s Dice at @loc{Casa Madrugada}. Deliver a Bandito bounty alive. Rescue Mexican residents from Banditos. Buy the final scrap at the Chuparosa general store.

For @item{Reyes’ Rebels Outfit}, loot the chest beside the inner southeastern wall of @loc{Sepulcro graveyard}. Finish @mechanic{Poppycock} and @mechanic{Love is the Opiate}. Complete Horsebreaking at @loc{Chuparosa}. Win Five Finger Fillet at @loc{Torquemada}. Buy the final scrap at the Escalera general store once @mechanic{An Appointed Time} is finished.

For @item{US Army Uniform}, loot the cabin chest at @loc{Aurora Basin}. Win Arm Wrestling at @loc{Pacific Union Railroad Camp}. Win Poker at @loc{Blackwater}. Finish @mechanic{Lights, Camera, Action}. Complete Blackwater Nightwatch. Buy the Blackwater tailor scrap once @mechanic{The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed} is finished.
Buy a safehouse in Mexico to receive @item{Mexican Poncho}. Finish @mechanic{The Outlaw’s Return} to receive @item{Rancher Outfit}.

With @mechanic{The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed} finished, earn @item{US Marshal Uniform} by clearing five hideouts within 24 game hours. Start at @loc{Gaptooth Breach}, ride to @loc{Tumbleweed}, then clear @loc{Fort Mercer}. Finish with @loc{Twin Rocks} and @loc{Pike’s Basin}. Avoid sleeping and fast travel during the attempt.
Check @mechanic{Stats > General > Game Completion} for 100%. Save after completing the remaining tasks.

achievements.description: Complete 20 story missions without replacing your owned horse.
achievements.summary: Complete 20 story missions without replacing your owned horse.

guide.context: Temporary horses required by story missions are allowed if you do not hitch them. This is missable if too few story missions remain for a new 20-mission streak.

steps.text: Start early. Use the included @item{War Horse deed} before beginning the streak, then complete 20 story missions with that horse as your owned mount.
Save between missions. Do not hitch a different horse or activate another horse deed. If your horse dies, reload the earlier save immediately.

achievements.displayName: Heading South on a White Bronco
achievements.description: Escape a US Marshal pursuit while riding a Hungarian Half-bred.
achievements.summary: Escape a US Marshal pursuit while riding a Hungarian Half-bred.

steps.text: Make a separate save and ride a @item{Hungarian Half-bred}, the white horse with a dark mane found in @loc{Nuevo Paraiso}. Stock Medicine and ammunition.
Build a US bounty by fighting deputies in @loc{Armadillo}. The doctor’s office counter provides cover. Escape, save and continue if Marshals have not yet appeared.
When the game announces a @enemy{US Marshal} posse, escape on the Hungarian Half-bred until the wanted search ends. Ordinary deputies and Mexican soldiers do not qualify.

achievements.description: Kill 500 enemies with a mounted weapon in any game mode.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 enemies with mounted guns or cannons.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Undead Nightmare}, use the cannon above the front gate of @loc{El Presidio}. Shoot the undead continually spawning outside until you reach 500 mounted-weapon kills. Save periodically and keep cannon shots away from the wall beneath you to avoid killing yourself.

achievements.description: Kill 500 enemies with any pistol or revolver in any game mode.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 enemies with pistols or revolvers.

steps.text: Use pistols and revolvers through the campaign. Finish any remaining kills by replaying gang hideouts with those weapons; headshots also advance @mechanic{Bullseye}.

achievements.description: Kill 500 enemies with any rifle, repeater, or shotgun in any game mode.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 enemies with rifles, repeaters or shotguns.

steps.text: Use rifles, repeaters and shotguns through the campaign. Replay gang hideouts with those weapons for remaining kills; the weapon types share the same 500-kill goal.

achievements.description: Get 250 headshots in any game mode.
achievements.summary: Kill 250 enemies with headshots.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Dead Eye} to target enemy heads during missions and hideouts until you reach 250 headshot kills.

achievements.description: Kill one of every animal species in the game in any game mode.
achievements.summary: Kill at least one of each of the 26 base-game wild animal species, excluding the Jackalope.

guide.context: Use the base campaign and check your animal kills in Stats > Misc. Domestic animals and the Jackalope are unnecessary; skinning is optional. These are convenient hunting areas, not exclusive spawns.

achievements.description: Complete all Tomahawk challenges.
achievements.summary: Finish all five ranks of Tomahawk Mastery in one campaign.

guide.context: This route uses the Undead Nightmare challenges. The base campaign has different requirements at some ranks.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Undead Nightmare}, save @loc{Manzanita Post} to receive the @item{Tomahawk} and complete rank 1.
At rank 2, get one thrown kill on foot, one melee kill and one mounted kill with the Tomahawk.
For rank 3, flush bats by firing near a large tree. Switch to the Tomahawk and kill a bat in flight; close-range Dead Eye helps.
At rank 4, make five Tomahawk kills in a row without missing. Melee attacks avoid the risk of a missed throw.

For rank 5, let a town come under attack, then defend the settlement with the Tomahawk as your only weapon. Survivor gunfire is allowed; do not damage undead with another weapon or by riding into them.

achievements.description: Complete the Explosive Rifle Challenge.
achievements.summary: Finish all five ranks of Explosive Rifle Mastery in one campaign.

guide.context: This route uses the Undead Nightmare challenges. Progress through the ranks in order; the base campaign uses a different rank 2.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Undead Nightmare}, save @loc{Rathskeller Fork} to receive the @item{Explosive Rifle} and complete rank 1.
At rank 2, kill a @enemy{Fresh Undead}, @enemy{Bolter}, @enemy{Bruiser} and @enemy{Retcher} with the rifle.
At rank 3, gather three undead together and kill them with one shot. At rank 4, kill two undead animals with one shot; wolf or coyote packs make suitable targets.
During @mechanic{American Imperialism}, obtain and wear the @item{US Army Uniform}. With that outfit equipped, shoot an undead using the Explosive Rifle to finish rank 5.

achievements.summary: Finish “Curious Tales from Blackwater, USA” in Undead Nightmare.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Curious Tales from Blackwater, USA} during the opening @loc{Blackwater} section of @mechanic{Undead Nightmare}.

achievements.summary: Finish both Undead Nightmare missions “Get Back in That Hole, Partner” plus “A Cure for Most of What Ails You”.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Undead Nightmare}, finish @mechanic{Get Back in That Hole, Partner} as well as @mechanic{A Cure for Most of What Ails You} during the New Austin story.

achievements.summary: Finish “Mother Superior Blues” in Undead Nightmare.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Mother Superior Blues} for the @npc{Mother Superior} at @loc{Las Hermanas}, after @mechanic{American Imperialism} opens Mexico.

achievements.description: Finish the final Undead Nightmare mission, “On a Pale Horse”.
achievements.summary: Finish the final Undead Nightmare mission, “On a Pale Horse”.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{A Civilized Man} in @loc{Escalera}, return the mask in the catacombs and watch the ending through @mechanic{On a Pale Horse}.

guide.context: Mexico opens after American Imperialism. Recheck the map after saving the last territory and retake any places that have fallen. Safehouse beds let you fast travel between safe towns. Fort Mercer, Casa Madrugada and El Presidio cannot be overrun.

achievements.description: Attain 100% Game Completion statistic in Undead Nightmare.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% in Undead Nightmare’s Game Completion statistic.

guide.context: Territory and cemetery completion credit remains after another attack. Only Spinning Plates requires simultaneous safety. Tomahawk and Explosive Rifle challenges are separate from this percentage.

steps.text: Finish the Undead Nightmare story. Complete these side missions too: @mechanic{Paternal Pride}, @mechanic{Birth of the Conservation Movement}, @mechanic{Missing Souls}, @mechanic{Dinner for Two}, @mechanic{Biographies and Lies} and @mechanic{Filth and Other Entertainment}. Follow any remaining mission markers.

Save each territory listed under @mechanic{Spinning Plates} at least once. Cleanse the cemeteries at @loc{Coot’s Chapel}, @loc{Blackwater}, @loc{Tumbleweed}, @loc{Odd Fellow’s Rest} and @loc{Sepulcro} by burning their marked coffins and killing the undead.

Finish all 10 missing-person rescues posted at @loc{Fort Mercer} and all 6 at @loc{El Presidio}. Take a poster, rescue the person and escort them back alive. Walk away from the poster spot and return for the next one.

Reach rank 5 in @mechanic{Undead Treasure Hunter}, @mechanic{Four Horses of the Apocalypse}, @mechanic{Undead Sharpshooter} and @mechanic{Undead Hunter}; follow @mechanic{Mad Marston: The Trail Warrior}.

Complete the @item{Undead Hunter} outfit scraps: Birth of the Conservation Movement, Filth and Other Entertainment, Missing Souls, one El Presidio rescue and the unicorn from @mechanic{Fan Service}. In postgame, the outfit becomes @item{Army of the Undead}. The story and completed challenge tracks grant the other completion outfits.
Check @mechanic{Stats > General > Game Completion} and finish any remaining category until it reaches 100%.

achievements.description: Attain Rank 5 in all Undead Nightmare Challenges.
achievements.summary: Reach rank 5 in all four Undead Nightmare challenge tracks.

guide.context: Ranks must be completed in order within each track, but you can advance different tracks together. Tomahawk Mastery and Explosive Rifle Mastery do not count toward this achievement.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Journal > Challenges} and work on each active rank. The four required tracks are @mechanic{Undead Hunter}, @mechanic{Undead Sharpshooter}, @mechanic{Undead Treasure Hunter} and @mechanic{Four Horses of the Apocalypse}.

For @mechanic{Undead Hunter}, rank 1 needs 25 Bolter kills and 100 Fresh Undead kills. Rank 2 needs 15 Retcher kills and 25 Bruiser kills. At rank 3, draw two undead beside a Retcher with Undead Bait, then shoot the Retcher so its explosion kills both.

For Hunter rank 4, use the @item{Torch} to kill 3 undead cougars, 2 undead bears and 5 undead wolves. A sturdy horse such as @item{Pestilence} helps. Search @loc{Tall Trees/Aurora Basin} for bears and @loc{Rio Bravo/Repentance Rock} for cougars; bait can distract the animals. Then kill the @enemy{Chupacabra} in Mexico for rank 5.

For @mechanic{Undead Sharpshooter}, gun-kill 5 undead within 10 seconds, then make 10 headshot kills in a row without Dead Eye. Next, set a group alight with a Fire Bottle and shoot 5 burning undead during one Dead Eye use before the fire kills them.

At Sharpshooter rank 4, kill a Fresh Undead, Bolter, Bruiser and Retcher during one Dead Eye use. Check the crowd outside @loc{El Presidio}. At rank 5, kill 5 undead with a sniper rifle within 8 seconds without Dead Eye. The @item{Rolling Block Rifle} comes from saving @loc{Pacific Union Railroad Camp}; bait a crowd at El Presidio or shoot down from the banks above @loc{Jorge’s Gap}.

For @mechanic{Four Horses of the Apocalypse}, lasso and break @item{War} in @loc{New Austin}, @item{Pestilence} in @loc{West Elizabeth}, @item{Famine} in @loc{Nuevo Paraiso} and @item{Death}. Watch for blue mythical-creature circles. If you do not find Death in the wild, finish the story to receive that horse.

Once the four horses are registered, ride @item{Death} over a Fresh Undead, Bolter, Bruiser and Retcher to finish rank 5. Search @loc{Jorge’s Gap}, @loc{Gaptooth Ridge} or outside @loc{El Presidio} for the enemy types.

For @mechanic{Undead Treasure Hunter}, search chests at the random @mechanic{cannibal camp} or @mechanic{scientist camp} events until you find the first treasure map. Each treasure supplies the next map.

For treasure rank 1, ride north from @loc{MacFarlane’s Ranch} toward @loc{Pike’s Basin}. Cross above the railway tunnel and follow the uphill route into the snowy box canyon. Search the stone pile at the dead end.
For treasure rank 2, search the cliff ledge east of @loc{Venter’s Place}. Approach from the north to reach the ledge and its stone pile.
For treasure rank 3, climb the back of the hill overlooking @loc{The Scratching Post}. Search the stone pile on top, between the two peaks.
For treasure rank 4, ride south from @loc{Sepulcro} into the hollow between the hills. Pass the first two trees and search among the next group of three trees.
For treasure rank 5, follow the railway southwest of @loc{Casa Madrugada}. Reach the cliff ledge by climbing the small hill to the west, then search its stone pile.

achievements.description: Break the unicorn in Undead Nightmare.
achievements.summary: Break the unicorn in Undead Nightmare.

steps.text: Complete the four Undead Nightmare challenge tracks, including the Chupacabra hunt. Search the horse drawing in @loc{Diez Coronas}, northwest of @loc{Torquemada}.
Look for a white horse with a horn and a rainbow trail; the unicorn does not create a blue mythical-creature circle. Lasso, mount and break the unicorn.

achievements.description: Kill the Chupacabra in Undead Nightmare.
achievements.summary: Kill the Chupacabra in Undead Nightmare.

steps.text: Complete the first four @mechanic{Undead Hunter} ranks so the Chupacabra can spawn at rank 5.

Patrol @loc{Nuevo Paraiso}, including the countryside near @loc{Torquemada} and the @loc{Chuparosa–Las Hermanas–Sepulcro} area. Check blue mythical-creature markers. Find the Chupacabra and shoot the creature; keep searching if a patrol produces no spawn.

achievements.description: Kill a sasquatch in Undead Nightmare.
achievements.summary: Kill a sasquatch in Undead Nightmare.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Birth of the Conservation Movement} near @loc{Tanner’s Reach/Aurora Basin} in @loc{Tall Trees}. Enter a marked search area and shoot a sasquatch.
